mechanism: Begin with one subject performing a complete, readable form that establishes both a movement signature and a material trace. Let environmental residue from that performance accumulate before it condenses into an independent adversary; the opponent must visibly originate from the established material family. Use one spatial crossing to bring both agents into a shared confrontation, introduce a contrasting second material only at the late peak, and close on a readable subject state after the material collision.

invariants.rule: Establish one subject's complete movement signature and its material trace before an opponent appears.
invariants.purpose: Creates the action vocabulary and origin material.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate enemy gives the material no causal history.

invariants.rule: Accumulate the same environmental material around the subject before it gains agency.
invariants.purpose: Makes the adversary an outcome of the established field.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random arriving character is only an unrelated antagonist.

invariants.rule: Condense the material into an independent opponent and bring both agents onto one readable spatial route.
invariants.purpose: Converts solo proof into a causal confrontation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Abstract weather without an opponent cannot test the movement signature.

invariants.rule: Reserve a contrasting second material for one late clash peak.
invariants.ablation_failure: Using both materials from the start flattens the hierarchy.

invariants.rule: After the collision, restore one readable subject state with the signature action or tool still identifiable.
invariants.purpose: Closes the arc on agency rather than pure spectacle.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending inside debris leaves the causal winner and retained skill unclear.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source Chinese ink-wash mountains and bamboo
the source tiger and serpentine ink adversaries
the source curved sword and exact martial choreography
the source black-ink and gold-energy battle order plus Hailuo/MiniMax watermarks

instantiations.concept: In an original glass desert, a lone airflow engineer uses a resonant ring to draw one clear spiral pressure pattern. Sand-laden wind accumulates and crystallizes into a four-legged glass adversary; both cross one suspended kiln bridge, where a late cobalt molten stream meets the clear pressure field before the engineer returns to a stable ring-control stance.

instantiations.concept: In a tactile paper observatory, a small clockwork weather vane performs three directional turns that leave folded ribbon wakes. The ribbons gather into an autonomous storm puppet, both travel across a rotating paper orrery, and only at the peak does a silver foil current collide with the matte storm before the vane locks into its original north-pointing posture.
